summary:
Power BI Developer and Data Visualization Analyst with 6.5+ years of experience owning end-to-end data visualization
initiatives — from data modelling and advanced DAX development to dashboard design, AI-powered insights, and
stakeholder reporting. Expert in transforming complex datasets into intuitive, high-performance dashboards with strong
UX, including Power BI Mobile implementations. Deep proficiency in advanced DAX (time intelligence, complex
measures, performance optimization), SQL (joins, CTEs, window functions, query tuning), and schema design. Proven
ability to investigate data discrepancies, identify root causes of quality issues, and collaborate cross-functionally to ensure
accuracy and reliability. Experienced in leveraging Generative AI tools to automate insight generation, build AI narrative
summaries, and enhance analytical productivity. Familiar with Figma for dashboard wireframing and prototyping prior to
development. Track record of serving 150+ business users, reducing report refresh time by 40%, and eliminating 60%+
manual effort across enterprise BI environments.

bullets: Power BI Dashboard Development: Designed and delivered end-to-end Power BI dashboards and reports — including Power BI Mobile implementations — incorporating AI-powered smart narratives and automated summary generation, reducing manual analytical effort by ~25% and accelerating executive reporting turnaround.

Data Quality & Dashboard UX: Investigated data discrepancies, anomalies, and inconsistencies across reports — identified root causes, collaborated with stakeholders to resolve data quality issues, and iteratively refined DAX logic and dashboard UX, cutting revision cycles by ~30%.

Advanced Data Modelling: Architected Star Schema and composite data models on 15M+ row datasets supporting 150+ business users — applying Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) for scalable, governed data layers with robust data quality checks and validation controls.

Figma & Dashboard Prototyping: Created dashboard wireframes and design prototypes using Figma to align UI/UX with business stakeholders before development — collaborated with Finance and Operations leadership to define and implement KPI frameworks, enabling self-serve analytics across business units.
Performance Optimisation: Applied incremental refresh, query folding, aggregation tables, and DAX best practices — reducing report refresh time by 40% and improving dashboard responsiveness by 35%.

ETL & Pipeline Management: Designed and maintained end-to-end data pipelines with gateway configuration, deployment pipelines, and scheduled refresh — ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and 99%+ pipeline reliability.

AI Narrative Insights: Developed AI-based narrative summaries and insight generation using Generative AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT) — helping business users interpret dashboard outputs effectively and enabling C-suite and Director-level stakeholders to act on data-driven findings.

Documentation & Governance: Documented data logic, metric definitions, assumptions, and transformation rules across all reporting solutions — establishing analytics standards and governance frameworks to ensure transparency, consistency, and team delivery quality.

jobs.role: Data Analyst – Analytics & Business Intelligence AkzoNobel India Limited •
jobs.company: Data Discrepancy Investigation: Systematically investigated data discrepancies, anomalies, and reporting inconsistencies across dashboards — identified root causes through statistical analysis and query validation, collaborating with stakeholders to resolve issues before full report rollout.
bullets: Sales Analytics & Forecasting: Developed Python-based analytical models for sales trend forecasting and performance tracking — delivering forward-looking insights to Finance and Sales Directors to enable proactive strategy adjustments.

Advanced SQL & Database Optimisation: Engineered complex SQL queries using CTEs, window functions, and stored procedures on Snowflake (20M+ records) — optimised query performance by 35–40% through indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and ongoing performance monitoring aligned with database administration best practices.

Analytical Reporting & Documentation: Prepared analytical reports, insight summaries, and solution documentation — enriched with domain expertise and structured for senior leadership consumption, supporting data-driven decision-making across Finance and Sales functions.

ETL Automation & Data Pipeline: Automated multi-step ETL workflows using Power Automate, ADF-style pipelines, and VBA macros — eliminating ~20 hrs/week of manual data processing (60% effort reduction), improving data freshness, and ensuring consistent data quality outputs.

Data Quality & Governance: Implemented data quality checks, validation rules, and metadata management practices — alongside RLS and RBAC controls ensuring compliant, auditable data delivery aligned with GDPR- aware design.

Report Performance & Scalability: Designed and continuously evaluated Power BI environments for performance, usability, and scalability — deploying governed data models, certified datasets, and RLS to enable 100+ non- technical users to independently access trusted, accurate data.

Cross-regional KPI Reporting: Delivered structured KPI dashboards enabling cross-regional sales visibility and performance tracking — directly informing distribution strategy decisions across APAC and EMEA regions.

jobs.company: Stakeholder Requirement Gathering: Led structured requirement workshops with global cross-functional stakeholders — translated ambiguous business needs into precise data specifications using user story and use- case documentation frameworks.
bullets: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA): Conducted comprehensive EDA using Python (Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn) and SQL to uncover patterns, outliers, and trends — forming the analytical foundation for client-facing dashboard and reporting solutions.
Multi-domain BI Delivery: Developed interactive Power BI dashboards, Tableau reports, and Excel-based analytical models for enterprise clients across Finance, Retail, and Manufacturing domains.

Statistical Analysis & Reporting: Applied regression analysis, variance analysis, and cohort analysis techniques to produce statistically robust insights — improving decision confidence for client leadership teams.

Power Platform Automation: Developed VBA-based automation solutions and Power Automate workflows to streamline data processing, automate recurring reporting tasks, and reduce manual intervention — improving accuracy, reducing turnaround time, and enhancing overall workflow efficiency.

Process Improvement & Documentation: Standardised analytics processes and technical documentation across teams — built reusable templates, DAX libraries, and SQL snippet repositories to accelerate future delivery.
